newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products down $2 apart from flat fuel barg.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products down $2 apart from flat fuel barg.

text.p: NWE oil products mostly fell about $2 a tonne on Wednesday morning but fuel was steady.
Gasoline and naphtha lost $2 a tonne tracking weaker crude and poor prompt demand. Gasoline barges traded at $202 and $204.50.
Gas oil fell $1.75 a tonne to $168.25 on June IPE but premiums for Rotterdam barges were unchanged around $1.25 above the screem.
Heavy fuel was steady trading at $82.50 and $82.75 before climbing to trade up to $84.50.
